title: cytisus grandiflorus subsp. barbarus
intro: Cytisus grandiflorus subsp. barbarus, commonly known as the Tree Spur or Italian Broom, is a perennial shrub native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its antioxidant and flavonoid properties. The therapeutic actions of Cytisus grandiflorus subsp. barbarus include its ability to act as a vasodilator, lowering blood pressure, and exhibiting antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
